author: LegitCritic87
quote:
WTF is this? I didn't buy GTA to do what I already do IRL with my wife. I wanted to get the greatest game of all time, (or so I thought) to wreak havoc from the jump. The game prevents you from doing so. How do you call this grand theft auto if you can't commit grand theft? Where are the hookers? I give it a 0 for story, graphics are phenomenal and outside world stuff is fun (some areas limited) but over-all a straight 1. This was a cash grab, bait n' switch. Rockstar hasn't been the same since Dan Houser left. What an embarrassment. Here is a list of what I've experienced: 

Why does everything feel like a damn chore? I wanted to play GTA, not do a second job.
You can't just cruise through a neighborhood and steal whatever car you want.
Where the hell are the hookers? They don't even exist.
Everything feels overly restricted compared to previous GTA games.
I don't want to spend half my time doing everyday activities.
Why does everything have to be so realistic? It's a video game.
I miss being able to cause absolute chaos without the game making everything complicated.
The police seem like they take forever to lose.
Why does it feel like I'm constantly being told what I can and can't do?Too many activities feel like pointless busywork.
I want to steal cars, rob people and cause trouble without jumping through hoops.
The game sometimes feels more like a life simulator than GTA.
Why are basic things so unnecessarily complicated?
I don't want to spend my gaming session running errands.
The game takes away some of the freedom that made GTA fun.
I want more random encounters instead of everything feeling scripted.
Why does everything have to be an entire mission?
I miss the ridiculous freedom of GTA San Andreas and GTA 5.
There's too much emphasis on realism and not enough on having fun.
After waiting this long, I expected to feel like a criminal in a sandbox, not somebody completing a daily chore list.
 
I'm done with Rockslop. I'll never buy a GTA game again, let alone... I highly doubt another one would be made. Dan Houser was the heart of rockstar and when you don't have him you have Relationship Simpulator Girl Boss 6. No thanks, I expect everyone to request a refund as I did. Rockstar is done for.
